meta.title: {brand} — a diary for your gut
meta.description: Track food, symptoms, stress and sleep, and after a few weeks discover what your IBS symptoms seem to relate to. Everything stays on your own phone.
meta.ogAlt: {brand}: food, stress or sleep? Find out what your gut does.

bristol.label: Stool (Bristol)
bristol.hint: Optional. Type 1 is hard, type 7 is watery.

landing.title: Food, stress or sleep?
landing.titleAccent: Find out what your gut does.
landing.lead: Log what you eat, how your gut feels and how tense you are in ten seconds. After a few weeks, {brand} shows what your symptoms seem to relate to.

one.title: Log
one.body: Three big buttons: food, symptom, stress. The time is already set. Done before your coffee cools.

two.title: See the pattern
two.body: After about two weeks you'll see whether your symptoms mostly go with what you eat, with stress, or with your sleep.

three.title: Talk it through
three.body: Bring your overview to your GP or a gastro dietitian. Export it as a file whenever you like.

landing.loopTitle: Gut and mind talk to each other
landing.loopBody: Stress can make your gut more restless, and a restless gut causes stress. Sometimes before anything happens: the tension before a train ride or an appointment. {brand} tracks that ‘stress beforehand’ separately, so you can see the loop.
landing.privacyBody: Everything you enter stays on your own phone. No account, no server keeping your data, no tracker watching. We can't see your data, even if we wanted to.

privacyPoints.export: Export and erase whenever you want

landing.insightTitle: No charts for the sake of charts.
landing.insightBody: A summary in plain language, with how much data it is based on. Carefully worded: {brand} shows patterns and never diagnoses.

faq.a1: No. {brand} shows patterns in what you track yourself. Always discuss what you see with your GP or a (gastro) dietitian before changing your diet or lifestyle.
faq.a2: Only in your browser on this device (IndexedDB). Make a backup now and then via Settings, because clearing your browser data erases it.
faq.a3: Yes. After your first visit you can install {brand} on your home screen and everything works offline.
faq.a4: Nothing. No subscriptions and no ads.

landing.finalTitle: Start today. Your gut will tell the rest.
landing.footerDisclaimer: {brand} gives insight into patterns and is not a medical device. It does not diagnose or give treatment advice.

privacy.title: Privacy, in plain language
privacy.intro: {brand} was built on one promise: what you track about your gut stays yours. Here's exactly what that means.

where.title: Where is my data?
where.body: Everything you enter (meals, symptoms, stress, sleep and notes) is stored in your browser's storage on this device (IndexedDB). It is never sent to us or anyone else.

account.title: Do I need an account?
account.body: No. There is no account, no email and no password, so we can't see who you are either.

analytics.title: Do you measure anything?
analytics.body: Only on the public home page do we count visits, anonymously and without cookies (Vercel Web Analytics). Inside the app we measure nothing at all, and your health data never ends up in those statistics.

backup.title: What if I lose my phone?
backup.body: Because we don't store your data, we can't restore it either. Make a backup now and then via Settings → Export. {brand} will gently remind you.

control.title: Can I erase everything?
control.body: Yes. Settings → Erase everything removes all data from this device at once. Clearing your browser data works too.

medical.title: Not medical advice
medical.body: {brand} shows patterns but does not diagnose or give treatment advice. Discuss what you see with your GP or a (gastro) dietitian.

s1.title: A diary for your gut.
s1.body: Log what you eat, when your gut acts up and when you're stressed. It takes a few taps each time.

s2.title: After two weeks, patterns appear.
s2.body: {brand} compares your symptoms with your food, stress and sleep. The more you log, the clearer the picture.

s3.title: Everything stays on this device.
s3.body: No account, no server, no trackers. Make a backup now and then, because we can't restore anything for you.

s4.title: Insight, not a diagnosis.
s4.body: {brand} shows what seems related. That is not medical advice. Discuss patterns with your GP or a (gastro) dietitian before changing anything.

s5.title: What do you want to keep an eye on?
s5.body: Pick the food tags you'll use often. They'll appear first. You can always change this later.

greeting.roughSub: Good that you're keeping track. Be a little kind to yourself today.

about.disclaimerBody: {brand} gives insight into patterns in your own data. It is not a medical device, does not diagnose and gives no treatment advice. Do you have persistent or new symptoms, blood in your stool, unintended weight loss or fever? Contact your GP.
